events.body:
## Context

README describes Poetry, Socket Mode, `app.py`, `.secrets.sample` and `src/sammich/plugins/*.py`, none of which exist; the bot is an HTTP Worker. The command table leaves out `/contrib`, `/stats`, `/blt`, `/blt-welcome`, `/installed_apps` and `/blt-app-url` from `manifest.yaml`.

## What to do

1. Rewrite Setup, Local Development, Project Structure and "Adding a New Command" around `wrangler dev`, `script/set-vars.sh` and `script/migrate.sh`.
2. Make the command table match `manifest.yaml` and the router; note commands handled in code but not registered.
3. Leave the reminders, event logging and welcome sections alone.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No Poetry, app.py or Socket Mode references
- [ ] Command table matches manifest.yaml

## How to test locally

```bash
Docs only.
```
